root_cause: The dispatch declared a required delegated helper with parallelism none, while the deterministic validator rejects none for every recommended or required strategy even when agent_count is one.
The helper receipt contract omitted four native-stage fields and four lifecycle-closeout fields required by the validator.
The native-stage receipt for s5-distill-proposer named invoke instead of the step's distill capability.
The repository-installed inventory capability was absent from the validator's canonical capability-id set and had no local metadata to classify it.
affected_invariant: A spawn-ready dispatch must return VALIDATION=pass rather than block or flag.
Every required helper receipt contract must cover native-stage evidence and explicit spawn, join, close, residue, and reroute lifecycle evidence.
A native-stage receipt must bind to the exact capability of its step.
A capability outside the validator's built-in catalog must carry explicit local classification metadata.
minimal_repair: Classified the one permitted delegated branch as fanout while explicitly preserving agent_count one and forbidding sibling agents or concurrency.
Added spawn_status, join_status, close_status, reroute, step_id, capability_ref, status, and observer_status to receipt_requirements.
Changed only the s5 native-stage receipt capability_ref from invoke to distill.
Added repository-installed source and validation metadata to s2-inventory.
